item: /performance runs the keyword export probe once, not twice: the warm export figure leaves the report (R460, OPEN_QUEUE item (19) answered)
summary: Diagnostics: GET /api/diagnostics/performance timed every probe twice, so the keyword_export_streamed probe ran two full scans of the mention rows. It now runs once (runs=(1,)); the other probes keep two runs. Measured cold on a generated encrypted store of 300,000 articles / 9,900,000 mentions (main 0982a0b1f, 4096-page store): route 38.5 and 38.9 s before, the export probe 18.0 + 16.6 s of it, so about 17 s saved; on RC2's slower box the same change is about 24.5 s of 58.7-59.8 s. The warm second export figure is no longer in performance.json (the OPEN_QUEUE item (19) design call, ruled R460). The report's selftest method string says so. Report: project files c9-measure/report-2026-11-07.md.
